facts.text: All first-year students are required to take an interdisciplinary Scribner Seminar capped at 16 students during their first semester.

sources.title: Scribner Seminar Program (SSP) | Skidmore College
sources.quote: All first-year students must take one Scribner Seminar in their first semester. This course must be taken for a letter grade.

sources.title: Scribner Seminar Program (SSP) | Skidmore College
sources.quote: Each seminar, limited to 16 first-year students, allows participants to work together closely and also acts as a foundation and context for future college studies.
